en.description:
From Burrowbop Studio.

Someone finally made good fidget toys for the Apple Watch.

WatchPop is a collection of tactile toys built for the wrist. Roll a marble around a walnut bowl with the Digital Crown and feel it coast and settle. Pop a sheet of bubble wrap that never runs out. Flick a spinner and let it wind down past the marker. Tilt your wrist to roll a ball through a maze. Every toy has real physics and its own haptics.

PLAY IT WITH ONE HAND

On watchOS 27, pinch your index finger and thumb to work the toy in front of you: pop the next bubble, flick the spinner, advance the dial a stop, scatter the pile.

Hand gestures need a watch with Double Tap, and Gestures turned on in Settings. Every toy still works by touch and Digital Crown without them.

ONE PINCH FROM THE WATCH FACE

Put the WatchPop widget in your Smart Stack and the toy you played last opens in a tap.

THE TOYS

Eight are free, forever:
Marble Bowl, a marble that rolls and settles under the crown.
Bubble Wrap, an endless sheet, one pop per tap.
Spinner, flick it and let it wind down past the marker.
Block Buddies, a pile of plushies to tilt, tumble, and scatter.
Combination Dial, turn through felt detents and feel the tumbler fall.
Zipper, one ratcheting tick per tooth, up and back down.
Watch Winder, the open heart of a mechanical watch: wind the crown, hear every tooth click, and watch the gears run down.
Snow Globe, shake your wrist and the snow swirls up around a cozy cabin.

The paid toys each play two ways, by finger and by wrist:
Pop Pad, press each dome with a thunk or sweep a whole row, turn the crown to flip the grid.
Tilt Stone, a stone that rolls up the side of the bowl when you turn your wrist, then finds its way home.
Critters, a little face to pet until its eyes close or fling and watch tumble, with six critters on the crown.
Tilt Maze, tilt a ball through a fresh maze and out the far side, then do it again.

And two Halloween toys: the jack-o'-lantern, whose carved light sweeps the page as you lean your wrist, and Spooky Critters, a witch, a skeleton and a bat to pet and fling.

SIX FINISHES

Workshop is free for everyone: warm walnut and brass. Machine is all metal, brushed steel and harder highlights. Studio is flat and modern, gradient white and pastel teal. Halloween is a spooky dusk, carved and glowing, and comes with the Halloween purchase. Winter Holiday is snowy and adds a village scene to the snow globe. Harvest is warm autumn color. A finish reskins your whole collection, art and palette together.

BUDDIES

Little companions for your wrist: pet them, feed them a treat, spin them with the crown. Sprout is free. Cats, Dogs, Dinos and Cosmic sell one pack at a time or all together. The Halloween, Winter Holiday and Harvest purchases each add six buddies.

WHAT IT COSTS

The free toys are complete and stay complete. No ads, no timers, no energy meters, no loot boxes, no subscriptions, nothing to grind, and no score to beat.

Buy something once and it restores, on your watch and your iPhone, with Family Sharing on. The best value is the Founder's Set: all four paid toys plus the Machine and Studio finishes in one purchase, yours to keep. Halloween, Winter Holiday, Harvest and the Buddies packs are sold separately.

BUILT TO BE QUIET

WatchPop works with no connection. Mute means mute, and a haptic sits behind every sound. Lower your wrist and the toy freezes where it stands instead of draining your battery inside your sleeve. Nothing here sends a notification.

VOICEOVER AND REDUCE MOTION

Every toy carries a VoiceOver label and speaks its state in words, with direct touch and custom actions for the ones you tap or drag. Crown toys are adjustable, one stop per swipe. Turn on Reduce Motion and the toys answer your hand just as fast, while the long coasts and tumbles settle short.

The iPhone app holds the gallery, the finishes, and the settings. The toys live on the watch, which is where your hands already are.
en.releaseNotes:
Two new toys, both free.

Compass: pick north, home, coffee, tacos or burgers, and your buddy turns to point the way. Walk closer and they lean in.

Weather: your buddy stands in the weather where you are, with the temperature. Snow, rain, sunshine or a starry night.

Each one gets its own critter and finish, picked on your watch or your phone. New watch face complications show your buddy and the weather.

Marmalade the cat now eats her treats and dances.

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
New toy: the Watch Winder. The Ratchet Wrench is now the inside of a real mechanical watch. Turn the Digital Crown or circle a finger on the screen to wind it, feel every tooth click, then watch the gears and balance wheel run down.

Fresh looks for three favorites: a brass zipper on canvas, a knurled combination dial, and a soft silicone Pop Pad, in all four finishes.

Plus a cleaner Studio preview and small fixes.
Studio update: WatchPop now comes from Burrowbop Studio, our new name. Same toys, same finishes, nothing else changes.

Two new finishes: Winter Holiday and Harvest

Winter Holiday: a snowy look for every toy, six winter buddies, and a village scene for your snow globe.

Harvest: warm autumn colors for every toy and six felt buddies.

The snow globe is free for everyone. Shake your wrist and the snow swirls up.

The iPhone app now fits both screens on iPhone Duo.
Flurry the snowman takes over the app icon for the holidays.

Set up your toys your way. The Play tab on your iPhone now lists every toy in its own row. Switch toys on or off, drag them into any order, and your watch follows along.

The Snow Globe now leads the lineup.

Flurry the snowman sits inside a watch on the app icon now, so WatchPop is easier to find on your phone.
